title: Parallel Data Processing Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Processes large datasets through coordinated parallel workloads. The Parallel Data Processing Engine splits a dataset into partitions, processes each partition with the same operation, and merges the partial results correctly — the map-reduce pattern. It handles partition sizing, worker coordination, and merge logic, reporting per-partition and total results. A parallel-processing method for data pipelines. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment. Defensive and engineering content only — no weapon-targeting or attack-execution content.
